kicker.label: Kicker
kicker.line: A lip across the whole track: a pop off it goes high.

ramp.label: Side ramp
ramp.line: A kicker over part of the track: taking it is a choice.

whoops.label: Whoops
whoops.line: A run of crests: pump them, or hop them.

bowl.label: Bowl
bowl.line: A stretch banked steep: lean on its wall.

lip.label: Glide lip
lip.line: Air over this stretch opens the glide by itself.

plate.label: Boost pad
plate.line: A sun plate: a flare's push for free.

lane.label: Recharge strip
lane.line: A vein lane: ride it and the pool refills.

geyser.label: Geyser
geyser.line: A slip geyser: it throws the board high on its cycle.

rail.label: Rail
rail.line: A ruin's lintel along the line: grind it.

ring.label: Sun ring
ring.line: A ring in the air: fly through it for a push.

column.label: Column
column.line: A standing stone to weave round (a near miss past it counts).

wall.label: Wall
wall.line: A clay wall across part of the track: a lane closed.

arch.label: Arch
arch.line: Two posts and a lintel: thread it.
